# IT Security and Database Migration Review Plan

This document details the planned activities for reviewing and investigating critical IT infrastructure and security components.

*   Review firewall settings based on audit.
*   Review encryption standards standard update.
*   Review database migration standard update.
*   Investigate encryption standards quarterly.
*   Investigate firewall settings urgently.
